baseline.limitation: Documentation snapshot, not installed-reference behavioral certification. Recheck documentation and add workflows when reference releases change.

scope: Parent areas are incomplete; checked boxes are bounded Engine acceptance checkpoints. No overall parity percentage.

items.title: Audio recorder
items.implemented: Desktop browser MediaRecorder inserts a local recording.
items.remaining: Device/codec behavior and Android microphone integration are unverified; no Android microphone permission is requested in this pilot.

items.title: Backlinks
items.implemented: Resolved backlinks and unlinked mentions exist.
items.remaining: Full reference context, rename/refactor edge cases and large-vault behavior remain incomplete.

items.title: Bases
items.implemented: Local `.base` table/list/cards views and a small extension view hook exist.
items.remaining: Full formula, query, grouping, configuration and extension-view APIs do not.

items.title: Bookmarks
items.implemented: Note bookmarks exist.
items.remaining: Groups, headings, saved searches and arbitrary URL bookmarks remain missing.

items.title: Canvas
items.implemented: Owned `.canvas` cards, connections, groups, zoom and editing exist.
items.remaining: This is not the internal Obsidian Canvas API required by Excalidraw's embedded-canvas path; deep interoperability and mobile touch workflows remain unverified.

items.title: Command palette
items.implemented: Fuzzy commands, keyboard selection and hotkey display exist.
items.remaining: Full ranking, pinning/recent behavior and arbitrary plugin command fidelity remain incomplete.

items.title: Daily notes
items.implemented: Configurable date format/folder/template and daily navigation exist.
items.remaining: All locale/timezone/template combinations remain unverified.

items.title: File explorer
items.implemented: Files/folders, rename, move, trash and attachments exist with host path/version guards.
items.remaining: No cross-process atomic lock, ACL preservation or power-loss guarantee is claimed. Android shared-folder selection is absent.

items.title: File recovery
items.implemented: Prior saved text versions and a recovery UI exist; up to 100 per file are retained.
items.remaining: The Android backend has a separate private profile, not the desktop recovery directory. Unsaved-process-kill recovery is not certified.

items.title: Footnotes view
items.implemented: Native current-note list, inline/named/repeated/unreferenced entries, source editing, per-reference navigation, live updates and core toggle; [contract and tests](FOOTNOTES.md).
items.remaining: Editing deliberately opens Source mode rather than a separate rich-text editor; complete installed-reference comparison and every syntax/device combination remain unverified.

items.title: Graph view
items.implemented: Owned global/local force graph, filtering and basic interaction exist.
items.remaining: Reference layout, visual controls and large-graph performance are not equivalent.

items.title: Note composer
items.implemented: Merge and selection extraction, including owned link handling, exist.
items.remaining: Every reference refactor/metadata/link edge case remains unverified.

items.title: Outgoing links
items.implemented: Indexed outgoing and unresolved links exist.
items.remaining: Full reference grouping/context/navigation behavior remains incomplete.

items.title: Outline
items.implemented: Heading navigation exists.
items.remaining: Full drag/reorder/reference behavior and all plugin headings remain incomplete.

items.title: Page preview
items.implemented: Owned note-hover previews exist.
items.remaining: Complete hover-parent ownership, popover behavior and plugin source integrations remain incomplete.

items.title: Properties view
items.implemented: Owned frontmatter/property editing and property indexing exist.
items.remaining: Arbitrary property types, complete metadata-manager semantics and reference layout remain incomplete.

items.title: Publish
items.implemented: Not in project scope.
items.remaining: Excluded by project policy.

items.title: Quick switcher
items.implemented: Fuzzy note selection exists.
items.remaining: Full ranking, context and modifier semantics remain incomplete.

items.title: Random note
items.implemented: Selects an eligible Markdown note.
items.remaining: Full option/filter/reference behavior is not certified.

items.title: Search
items.implemented: Indexed text, owned operators and result navigation exist.
items.remaining: Complete reference grammar, context, ranking and large-vault performance remain incomplete.

items.title: Slash commands
items.implemented: Shared command discovery/insertion exists.
items.remaining: Full cursor, mobile keyboard and plugin-command behavior is not certified.

items.title: Slides
items.implemented: Markdown slide rendering/navigation exists.
items.remaining: Complete presenter/export/reference behavior remains incomplete.

items.title: Sync
items.implemented: Not in project scope.
items.remaining: Excluded by project policy.

items.title: Tags view
items.implemented: Tag listing/filtering exists.
items.remaining: Complete reference hierarchy, counts and interaction remain incomplete.

items.title: Templates
items.implemented: Template insertion and owned date/title expansion exist.
items.remaining: Full third-party templating APIs/macros are not provided.

items.title: Unique note creator
items.implemented: Creates timestamp-formatted notes in a configured folder.
items.remaining: Every collision/template/date-format case remains unverified.

items.title: Web viewer
items.implemented: Desktop embedded web views and owned navigation exist.
items.remaining: Android remote frames are deliberately blocked; opening remote pages in a trusted native WebView is not enabled. Complete reference browser integration remains absent.

items.title: Word count
items.implemented: Active-document word/character counts exist.
items.remaining: Reference tokenization/selection/locale behavior is not identical.

items.title: Workspaces
items.implemented: Saved layouts restore tabs, split, modes and sidebars.
items.remaining: Arbitrary workspace-leaf/view hierarchy, every plugin state and mobile layout fidelity remain incomplete.

items.title: Desktop app
items.implemented: Electron shell and Windows/macOS/Linux package configuration; actual Linux-package regressions.
items.remaining: Windows/macOS runtime certification, signing/notarization, automatic updates, multi-window/pop-out equivalence.

items.title: Vaults
items.implemented: Desktop choose/create folder, last vault, file metadata/watch; Android private vault implementation under native test.
items.remaining: Vault catalog, concurrent windows, reference-settings migration and Android shared folders/SAF.

items.title: Save safety
items.implemented: Queued writes, SHA-256 optimistic conflicts, desktop replacement/close flush; staged Android publication.
items.remaining: Power-loss/fsync, cross-process locking, external-write races, ACL preservation and unsaved-process-kill recovery.

items.title: Explorer
items.implemented: Files/folders, rename/move, folder drag, sorting and trash.
items.remaining: Complete context menus, bulk selection and attachment/refactor handling across every embed type.

items.title: Links
items.implemented: Wiki/Markdown links, aliases, relative siblings, heading/block reads and owned rename updates.
items.remaining: Complete shortest-path disambiguation, escaped/parent-relative destinations and Canvas/Base/ambiguous rename references.

items.title: Tabs/layout
items.implemented: Tabs/reorder, back/forward, one right split and saved layouts.
items.remaining: Arbitrary split trees, stacked tabs, pane pinning/pop-outs and all plugin workspace states.

items.title: Import/export
items.implemented: Markdown/assets import and note/HTML/PDF/ZIP export on desktop; Android share export implementation under test.
items.remaining: Product-specific importers, self-contained HTML, Android printing/SAF and complete hidden-profile backup/restore.

items.title: Source editing
items.implemented: CodeMirror, Markdown, undo/redo, search/replace, selection formatting, spelling/line settings and an owned table editor.
items.remaining: Vim/Emacs mode equivalence, every editing shortcut, folding/history semantics and every input method.

items.title: Live preview
items.implemented: Source reveal, formatting, tasks, tables with row/column operations, owned fenced-block previews and repaired geometry/identity.
items.remaining: Obsidian Markdown processors still run only in reading mode; complete inline/nested grammar, every list/embed, cursor/selection equivalence and huge-document performance remain incomplete.

items.title: Reading
items.implemented: Markdown-it, tables, tasks, highlights, footnotes, comments and nested callout folding; dedicated Footnotes view can reveal editable source.
items.remaining: Complete OFM, HTML-in-note and code-fence highlighting equivalence remain unverified.

items.title: Math/diagrams
items.implemented: KaTeX and strict Mermaid with sanitized native SVG text labels.
items.remaining: All syntax/render/editing types and complete compatibility/security certification.

items.title: Embeds
items.implemented: Note/heading/block transclusion, read-only Canvas geometry and image/audio/video; PDF download.
items.remaining: Recursive embeds, Canvas file cards, interactive PDF, full wiki image sizing, embedded Bases and block edit actions.

items.title: Properties
items.implemented: Typed YAML editing, add/remove, property search and indexed inference/overrides used by the facade.
items.remaining: Full reference type-manager semantics, date/link widgets, drag/reorder, completion and multi-file bulk edits.

items.title: Attachments
items.implemented: Local asset import/display and ZIP inclusion; root paths and modified decoded assets repaired.
items.remaining: Large-file streaming, PDF viewing/annotation, every drag/paste path and per-folder rules; Android picker flows unverified.

items.title: Community plugin API
items.implemented: Default Worker and explicitly trusted renderer; owned document/workspace/storage/render providers; mobile flags and desktop-only refusal.
items.remaining: Full members, overloads, workspace semantics, platform workflows and plugin compatibility remain incomplete; per-plugin verdicts live only in the support matrix.

items.title: Community catalog
items.implemented: Local manually installed packages; Android debug sideload only.
items.remaining: No marketplace, unattended install/update/signing, or Android installation UI.

items.title: Themes/snippets
items.implemented: Original themes, editable custom CSS and bounded Style Settings controls.
items.remaining: Complete theme/snippet management and reference CSS-variable equivalence are unverified.

items.title: Hotkeys
items.implemented: Editable application hotkeys and owned plugin scopes.
items.remaining: Full conflict resolution, arbitrary editor overrides and mobile external-keyboard coverage are incomplete.

items.title: Mobile
items.implemented: Capacitor Android private-vault pilot: final #76 APK passed nine actual API35 workflows, including Chinese IME, keyboard/Back, persistence/failure recovery, plugins and OS chooser; [native evidence](https://github.com/crafactory/engine/actions/runs/42188594088).
items.remaining: iOS, SAF/shared vault selection, mobile plugin installer, full profile backup, production signing/upgrades and complete device/OEM coverage remain absent. New-head source changes require their own native gate.

items.title: CLI
items.implemented: Owned local-file CLI.
items.remaining: Not command-compatible with the reference CLI.

items.implemented: No browser extension.
items.remaining: Reference free-extension interoperability remains outstanding.

items.remaining: Full importer formats and geospatial workflows remain outstanding.

items.remaining: UI is currently English, not a translated Chinese interface.

items.remaining: Comprehensive screen-reader/device/accessibility audit remains outstanding.

items.remaining: Not a current core-index entry; complete conversion interoperability remains unverified.
